items.h: New York Today and Tonight: Met Tosca, Yo-Yo Ma at Carnegie, Sting
items.sum: The Met's Tosca matinee at 1 p.m., Silkroad Ensemble with Yo-Yo Ma at Carnegie Hall and Sting at Brooklyn Paramount headline a busy Saturday.

items.h: Stevie Wonder Brings 'Songs in the Key of Life' to the Garden
items.sum: Stevie Wonder marks 50 years of his landmark double album with a Madison Square Garden show on Thursday, Nov. 19.

items.h: Holiday Season Arrives: The 100th Macy's Parade, the Tree and the Rockettes
items.sum: The Rockefeller Center tree arrives Nov. 7, the Christmas Spectacular is underway at Radio City, and Macy's marches for the 100th time on Thanksgiving morning.

items.h: Sting Settles In for Eight Nights at Brooklyn Paramount
items.sum: Sting brings his stripped-down STING 3.0 trio to Downtown Brooklyn for eight shows between Nov. 11 and Nov. 21.

items.h: Gustavo Dudamel Leads the Philharmonic in Tosca at Carnegie Hall
items.sum: Two concert performances of Puccini's Tosca, November 13 and 15, mark Dudamel's first Philharmonic podium at Carnegie Hall.

items.h: Lincoln in the Bardo Closes at the Met on November 14
items.sum: Missy Mazzoli's opera after George Saunders' novel has its last performances through November 14.

items.h: JACK Quartet Plays Feldman at The Met Cloisters
items.sum: A Saturday afternoon of Morton Feldman's string music in the chapel at The Met Cloisters.

items.h: Siena bronzes fill the Frick through January 18
items.sum: Nearly forty Sienese works, including pieces by Donatello, form the Frick's first survey of Siena's bronze sculpture.

items.h: Iris van Herpen's Sculpting the Senses at the Brooklyn Museum
items.sum: More than 140 couture works and natural history specimens fill the galleries through December 6 in the designer's North American debut.

items.h: MasterVoices celebrates Handel at Carnegie Hall on Dec. 15
items.sum: Ted Sperling leads the MasterVoices Chorus and New York Baroque in a holiday Handel program.

items.h: Galileo begins Broadway previews at the Shubert Theatre
items.sum: Raúl Esparza stars in the new musical about Galileo Galilei, which opens Dec. 6.

items.h: Frank Huang Plays Mendelssohn With the New York Philharmonic
items.sum: Thursday, November 19 at 7:30 PM at David Geffen Hall in Lincoln Center, with further concerts on November 20 and 21.

items.h: Paul Taylor Dance Company Brings Three Premieres to Lincoln Center
items.sum: The company's November run at the David H. Koch Theater includes new works by Lovette, Battle and Tanowitz through November 22.

items.h: Saint-Saëns's Samson et Dalila Comes to the Met on December 18
items.sum: The Metropolitan Opera lists the Friday evening performance at 7 p.m. in its December season.

items.h: Kevin Puts's Bassoon Concerto Gets Its World Premiere at Geffen Hall
items.sum: Santtu-Matias Rouvali leads the New York Philharmonic at the Wu Tsai Theater on Nov. 25, 27 and 28 and Dec. 1 at 7:30 p.m., with bassoonist Judith LeClair.

items.h: Rihab Chaieb Sings Arabic Poetry at Carnegie
items.sum: A November 18 recital in Weill Recital Hall includes a US premiere.

items.h: Apollo's Fire and Jeanine De Bique at Zankel Hall
items.sum: A Baroque program led by Jeannette Sorrell on Sunday, Nov. 15.

items.h: Here There Are Blueberries Earns Four Stars on Broadway
items.sum: Time Out's critic calls the new Broadway play a feast of strange fruit.

items.h: Glykeria and Kostas Ageris Sing in Manhattan on November 14
items.sum: Saturday, November 14 at 9 PM in the Grand Ballroom at Manhattan Center in Midtown.

items.h: LaGuardia Students Stage Godspell Through November 22
items.sum: Student performers take on the 1971 musical across five performances at the college's Performing Arts Center.

items.h: Jeannette Sorrell Conducts Handel's Messiah at David Geffen Hall
items.sum: Four performances from Wednesday, Dec. 9 to Sunday, Dec. 13 in the Wu Tsai Theater at Lincoln Center, with Apollo's Singers and four soloists.

items.h: Rockefeller Center's 2026 tree arrives from West Edmeston
items.sum: The Norway spruce reached Midtown on November 7, ahead of the December 2 lighting ceremony.

items.h: A 750-Person Music Venue Is Opening Inside Williamsburg's Domino Sugar Refinery
items.sum: A new live-music room is opening inside the historic sugar refinery on the Williamsburg waterfront.

items.h: Black Belt Eagle Scout Plays the Met Auditorium
items.sum: Tuesday, November 17 at 7 PM, with Joe Rainey, in the Met's concert and lecture hall.

items.h: Met Opera Streams Lincoln in the Bardo at No Charge Saturday
items.sum: The Met streams its Lincoln in the Bardo production online Saturday at 8 p.m. as the run nears its close.

items.h: Harlem Gospel Choir Sings at the Blue Note on Sunday, November 22
items.sum: Sunday, November 22 at 1:30 PM at the Blue Note jazz club in Greenwich Village.

items.h: Trinity Church Pairs Marianna Martines With Mozart on November 18
items.sum: A one-hour Concerts at One program brings rarely heard Vienna music to lower Manhattan.

items.h: The Vanguard Jazz Orchestra Brings Big-Band Jazz to Trinity Church
items.sum: Sunday, Nov. 22 at 4 p.m. at Trinity Church on Broadway, part of the Jazz Icons series. The concert is sold out but can be watched online.

items.h: The Union Square Holiday Market Officially Opens
items.sum: The seasonal market opened in Union Square as the holiday shopping season gets underway.

items.h: Sitarist Rishab Rikhiram Sharma Plays Carnegie Hall on November 21
items.sum: Saturday, November 21 at Stern Auditorium in Carnegie Hall, Midtown.

items.h: Grand Bazaar's Autumn Bazaar Brings Makers and Vintage Sunday
items.sum: Vintage collectors, local makers, artists and food vendors gather on Columbus Avenue from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.

items.h: The Famous Phoenicia Diner Pops Up in Brooklyn This Weekend
items.sum: The Catskills diner is setting up a weekend pop-up in Brooklyn.

items.h: Sandbox Percussion Plays Steve Reich's Drumming at Trinity Church
items.sum: Sandbox Percussion and its mentored students perform the minimalist landmark on November 19 at 6:30 p.m.

items.h: Voodoo Doughnut Opens Next Week With a Glazed Doughnut Hot Dog
items.sum: The doughnut shop opens next week with a glazed doughnut hot dog on the menu.

items.h: NYBG's Holiday Train Show Opens Saturday in the Bronx
items.sum: Model trains run past about 200 miniature New York landmarks through January 10 at the Enid A. Haupt Conservatory.

items.h: A New Mexican Restaurant Opens Downtown With a 10-Course Taco Tasting
items.sum: The new downtown restaurant opens with a ten-course taco tasting menu.
